articles.title: In 2013, a Jeff Bezos-funded expedition pulled the remains of Saturn V F-1 engines up from more than 14,000 feet beneath the Atlantic, and a serial number uncovered beneath the corrosion tied one thrust chamber to Apollo 11, launched in July 1969 for the first crewed lunar landing
articles.summary: Remote-controlled submarines have discovered scattered wreckage of the Saturn V rocket engines, crucial for launching the first humans to the Moon, two and a half miles deep in the ocean. This significant find, made possible by advanced underwater technology, provides invaluable historical insights into early space exploration and humanity's groundbreaking scientific achievements, emphasizing recovery efforts.

articles.title: The Rules-Based Nuclear Bomb
articles.summary: Joseph Busby highlights the significant hypocrisies displayed by nuclear weapons states in their approach to nonproliferation. He criticizes their actions, including alterations to nuclear doctrines and efforts to desensitize the public regarding nuclear risks. This analysis underscores a double standard where established nuclear powers advocate against proliferation while simultaneously adjusting their own policies and public perception surrounding these critical defence assets.

articles.title: ISRO set to launch EOS-05, India’s first Earth observation satellite in GEO
articles.summary: ISRO is set to launch EOS-05, India's first Earth observation satellite, into Geosynchronous Orbit. This mission highlights India's growing space capabilities and technological prowess. The satellite will provide crucial data for weather forecasting, disaster management, and environmental monitoring, strengthening national infrastructure and strategic applications. This development underscores India's commitment to leveraging space technology for national benefit and global leadership.

articles.title: Wasim Akram says he helped Irfan Pathan become a better bowler, says he now tweets against Pakistan
articles.summary: Legendary Pakistan pacer Wasim Akram recently recalled providing crucial bowling advice to former Indian all-rounder Irfan Pathan early in his international career. Pathan, then a young left-arm bowler, sought guidance from the Pakistan great. This interaction highlights a spirit of mentorship transcending national rivalries, aiding Pathan's development as a significant player for India.

articles.title: View: From ‘Make in India’ to ‘Design in India’
articles.summary: India's automotive market, the world's third largest, navigates a persistent debate between promoting Indian brands and integrating foreign technology. The discussion extends beyond a simple binary, acknowledging the globalized nature of vehicle manufacturing where no single carmaker produces entirely domestic vehicles. This reflects the complex interplay of national identity, market growth, and international collaboration within a crucial economic sector.

articles.title: Indian Athletics Team For Asian Games Finalised With Replacements
articles.summary: The Indian athletics team for the upcoming Asian Games in Japan has undergone significant reshaping. Key replacements include Yashvir Singh stepping in for an injured Neeraj Chopra, a major development. Other alterations involved a controversial dropping, as the squad finalizes its roster. These adjustments aim to optimize India's performance in the international competition.

articles.title: The summer we love is slipping away
articles.summary: The article reflects on the evolving perception of summer, noting its shift from a childhood symbol of freedom and adventure. It highlights summer's enduring role for adult leisure and social enjoyment, while also observing how it was once more easily recognizable. The piece likely explores the changing experience of this season.

articles.title: Zorawar: The war machine built to counter China takes centre stage in India's Belgium defence outreach
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi highlighted India's collaboration with Belgium on modern defence equipment following delegation-level talks. He specifically cited the indigenous Zorawar light tank as a key example of their joint efforts. This cooperation underscores India's push for self-reliance in defence manufacturing while fostering international partnerships to enhance capabilities, crucial for SSB aspirants to understand strategic national developments.
